verdict.rationale: Pipecat documents transcript collection through turn events and Flows functions that can call external APIs. These are developer building blocks for building extraction yourself, not a built-in feature that extracts outcomes, entities or dispositions after each call. The only webhook in the evidence is the carrier's inbound-call webhook, and the Cloud REST API manages agents and sessions, not call data, so neither delivers extracted results.

support.subject: As a developer, I can extract structured data from every call — outcomes, entities, dispositions — delivered via API or webhook after the call
